lines: Каждая панель встаёт ровно по замеру.
say: Каждая панель встаёт ровно по замеру.
caption:
Монтаж стекла на балконе глазами мастера. Напишите СТЕКЛО в WhatsApp. #установка #остеклениебалкона #стекло #израиль

👉 reels.tepexa.com/w/5347ab92bdba713bdb58
why: Серия «Установка глазами мастера», формат пошаговой установки (6,1 млн у донора). Цель — доверие к процессу и охват.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames 4-7 (4.5-8.4s) are near-identical static shots of the building facade, with no motion or new information
The finished glazing is tiny and far away on the facade, so the result is not shown clearly or up close
Install frames 1-3 are good, but they cover only about 4 seconds and the glass is hard to read against the cluttered background
Caption in frame 1 sits over the worker's hands and glass, and the hook text duplicates the on-screen subtitle
Subtitles are cut into fragments (Каждая панель / замеру / Напишите СТЕКЛО в) and the line 'по замеру' appears late relative to the picture
qa.fix: Replace the four near-identical facade frames with varied close-ups of panels sliding in, leveling and the finished frameless balcony glazing, and show the result up close before the CTA end card.
